info.title: Harbour Universal API
info.description: Harbour is a document workflow platform for creating, sending, and managing documents and signatures.

put.description: Adds annotations to an existing document in Harbour.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

document_id.description: ID of the document to annotate.

field_values.description: Map of agreementinput-* field identifiers to annotation payloads, for example { "agreementinput-field": { "value": "Example" } }.

download_url.description: Signed URL to download the annotated file.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the download URL expires.

post.description: Creates a new agreement link in Harbour.

agreement_id.description: Agreement template identifier used to create the link.

brand_id.description: Brand identifier for the agreement link.

request_title.description: Title shown in the Harbour signature page.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode: PASSCODE, EMAILS, or PUBLIC.

passcode.description: Passcode value when auth_mode is PASSCODE.

post.description: Creates document insights from completed documents, drafts, or URLs in Harbour.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

draft_id.description: Harbour draft document identifier. Provide one of draft_id, completed_id, doc_text, or url.

completed_id.description: Harbour completed agreement asset identifier. Provide one of draft_id, completed_id, doc_text, or url.

doc_text.description: Raw document text to analyze. Provide one of draft_id, completed_id, doc_text, or url.

url.description: Publicly accessible document URL to analyze. Provide one of draft_id, completed_id, doc_text, or url.

context.description: Background context the model can use while generating insights.

insights[].description: List of Harbour insight request objects, for example [{ "type": "document_title" }, { "type": "contract_values" }].

stream.description: Whether Harbour should stream the insight generation response.
